name: Harmony Data Harmonization Dashboard
description: Installs and launches the Harmony Streamlit dashboard for agentic clinical data harmonization.

port.description: Port on which the Streamlit server listens.

gcsBucket.description: GCS bucket containing harmonization run artifacts.

gcsRootPrefix.description: Root prefix inside the GCS bucket containing mapping/ and audit/ folders.

datasetName.description: Display name of the dataset shown in the dashboard header.

datasetSubtitle.description: Subtitle shown beneath the dataset name.

localPath.description: Optional local or gcsfuse-mounted root path overriding GCS.
